en.title: TPWM Lab — Transportation Perception & World Modeling
en.description: Transportation-centered research in trustworthy multimodal perception, world modeling, traffic safety, and infrastructure optimization.
en.intro: We study reliable representations and predictions of traffic environments under heterogeneous, incomplete, and uncertain observations.
en.researchTitle:
One connected vision.
Multiple ways to explore.
en.researchIntro: Three core directions, complemented by a systems perspective. Reliability is the thread that connects them.
en.philosophyTitle:
How much can we trust
what we perceive and predict?
en.philosophyIntro: We connect observation quality, physical dynamics, scene semantics, and uncertainty to transportation questions. The pathway below is a research agenda, not a completed end-to-end system.
en.reliability: Across every direction: quality, uncertainty, physical consistency, and reliable evaluation.
en.publicationsIntro: Selected publications of the founding PI, including work completed before the formation of TPWM Lab.
en.fullList: Full publication list on the PI website
en.joinTitle:
Bring your questions.
Find a research direction.
en.joinIntro: We welcome conversations with students and collaborators interested in the intersection of transportation science and artificial intelligence.
en.studentBody: Curiosity, quantitative and programming foundations, research integrity, and an interest in real transportation challenges matter. A background in transportation, computer science, AI, automation, vehicle engineering, civil engineering, or mathematics can offer a starting point.
en.collabBody: We are interested in multimodal sensing, road-user interactions, traffic safety, transportation world modeling, and infrastructure decisions. Shared questions and the available data will shape each collaboration.
en.joinNotice: Research inquiries are welcome. Recruitment eligibility, degree programs, positions, and supervision arrangements are subject to university policies and future official announcements. No current opening is advertised here.

paths.title: AI & computer science
paths.body: Detection and tracking → scene representation → interaction-aware prediction

paths.title: Transportation engineering
paths.body: Trajectories and traffic conflicts → uncertainty analysis → reliable safety evaluation

paths.title: Automation, vehicles & mathematics
paths.body: State estimation and dynamics → physical constraints → prediction and optimization

zh.title: TPWM Lab — 交通感知与世界建模研究组
zh.description: 以交通科学问题为导向，研究可信多模态交通感知、世界建模、交通安全与基础设施优化。
zh.eyebrow: 交通科学 × 人工智能
zh.heroTitle:
感知交通，理解场景。
预测演化，守护安全。
zh.fullName: 交通感知与世界建模研究组
zh.intro: 我们关注异构观测、信息缺失与不确定性条件下，如何可靠地理解交通场景，并预测其未来演化。
zh.figureNote: 概念示意 · 非实测数据或实验结果
zh.researchTitle:
相互连接的研究主线，
多元开放的探索入口。
zh.researchIntro: 三个核心方向，加上系统优化的特色拓展。可信性与可靠性贯穿其中。
zh.startLabel: 可探索的学生入门课题
zh.philosophyTitle:
我们能在多大程度上相信
感知与预测的结果？
zh.philosophyIntro: 以真实交通问题为导向，连接观测质量、物理运动、场景语义与不确定性。下图表达研究路线，不代表已经建成的端到端系统。

flow.title: 异构多源观测
flow.body: LiDAR · 相机 · 雷达 · 无人机 · V2X

flow.title: 质量感知的场景表示
flow.body: 检测 · 跟踪 · 融合 · 不确定性

flow.title: 交通世界建模
flow.body: 时空状态 · 主体交互 · 物理 · 语义

flow.title: 安全分析与系统决策
flow.body: 冲突分析 · 风险预测 · 多目标优化

zh.reliability: 跨方向的共同主题：观测质量、不确定性、物理一致性与评估可靠性。
zh.publicationsIntro: 研究组发起人的精选论文，包含在研究组形成之前完成的工作。
zh.fullList: 前往个人主页查看完整论文列表
zh.peopleTitle:
从一个研究愿景，
走向共同探索。
zh.joinTitle:
带着问题而来，
找到你的研究方向。
zh.joinIntro: 欢迎对交通科学与人工智能交叉研究感兴趣的同学与合作者交流。
zh.studentBody: 我们重视主动探索问题的能力、数学与编程基础、学术诚信，以及对真实交通问题的兴趣。交通运输、计算机、人工智能、自动化、车辆、土木、数学及相关专业，都可以找到适合的研究入口。
zh.collabBody: 欢迎围绕多模态感知、交通参与者交互、交通安全、交通世界建模与基础设施决策展开讨论。具体合作方向将结合双方的研究兴趣与数据资源条件共同确定。
zh.joinNotice: 欢迎科研交流。正式招生资格、招生专业、名额与指导安排，以学校政策和未来正式公告为准。本页面不代表当前已有开放名额。
